title: The healthy level against M, rescored; what spreads it between cell types
set_out: Settle whether the healthy held error follows odds of M or 1 + M; split its spread into meter, samples and cell types; rescore the middle-number tests by the agreed bar method; finish the seventh self-calibration form.
open_at_turnover: The Deconvolver given the cut end calls (plant before trim), one canary first; restore crew and copying as predictors of each cell type's delivery share; the ATP table per tissue; the day summary.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: M or M + 1 on spent counts
entries.what: The healthy lone-loss intercept on the 153 and the 54 Loyfer samples (m_or_m_plus_1.py).
entries.outcome: Pooled 0.04526 (0.04375-0.04657): odds of M favored over 1 + M; the two sets differ mainly by cell mix.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: The held-error counters on molecules whose truth we set
entries.what: Synthetic molecules with a planted loss, read by the one command (counter_synthetic.py).
entries.outcome: Every counter reads low; the length-corrected one is right at zero loose; at the real clustering the true lone-loss rate sits near 0.046-0.048.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): synthetic molecules with a planted truth

entries.title: Hairpin time course
entries.what: Nine spent SKO files, three clones over 45 days (timecourse.py).
entries.outcome: Each clone's restore/loss odds stay within 4-8 % while its mark level rises up to 20 %.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: The spread split three ways
entries.what: 150 healthy samples against the M-based prediction (scatter_split.py).
entries.outcome: Meter under 1 %; samples of one cell type 2.9 %; between cell types 6.7 %.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: Held error against how often a cell is replaced
entries.what: 27 cell types paired with the published turnover census (lifespan_vs_held.py).
entries.outcome: Rarely replaced types hold slightly worse (Spearman 0.47, p 0.014); 18 of the 27 pairings use a parent type.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: The middle-number tests rescored
entries.what: The three PHY-050 tests as pulls at k = 2 (rescore_middle.py); the sealed verdicts stand.
entries.outcome: Test 3 (lone-loss rate, 54 unseen samples) agrees within about half a standard deviation; tests 1 and 2 remain misses.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: Restore crew against held error
entries.what: Human Protein Atlas DNMT1 + UHRF1 against each cell type's held error (crew_vs_held.py).
entries.outcome: More crew, lower held error (rho -0.43, p 0.019, 29 types).
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: Self-calibration synthetic, seventh form
entries.what: The same 15 planted rows, each library and the atlas read past each side's molecule-end reach.
entries.outcome: Not met: end errors absorbed in 1 of 9; a real change kept 3 of 3; laboratories not brought together. The planted calls still reach the reading, most likely through the Deconvolver.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (its three-call inner reference, metaa_inner_reference_t3)

entries.title: How test bars are set
entries.what: A bar is the combined measured uncertainty at k = 2 (the metrology guide); results are reported as pulls (Why IAM, Read first).
entries.outcome: Written into both copies of Why IAM.

entries.title: Three-call atlas inner reference
entries.what: metaa_inner_reference_t3, counted from the atlas's own donors past three calls.
entries.outcome: Registered in the reference manifest; used by the seventh form.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: The spread is mostly the cell type
entries.what: Meter, samples and cell types measured separately.
entries.outcome: The instrument is clean; the cell-type part is the delivery share phi moving about +/-5 %, not the coin.

entries.title: Bars narrower than the body's own spread
entries.what: The PHY-050 third test held each sample to 10 % while healthy samples spread 7.5 %.
entries.outcome: On the baseline question it passes at about 1 sigma; bars now come from measured uncertainty.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes, and what caught each

entries.title: ln(1 + M) raised as a lead too soon
entries.what: It matched the canon's holding energy, which is the raw counter at each sample's own loose share.
entries.outcome: Withdrawn after the code check on two counters; its closeness is two offsetting meter effects.

entries.title: Lifespan record counted 14 parent pairings
entries.what: The record said 14; the table holds 18 of 27.

entries.title: A correction started while a commit was in flight
entries.what: The merge conflicted and left the local log behind main.
entries.outcome: Main's copy restored by the API and the one line fixed; one writer per file again.
